body.x: Terraillon introduced a smart sleep solution, Homni, which helps users in the best sleep conditions at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' held in Las Vegas on January 7th (Sunday).

Terraillon has created Homni, a smart sleep solution which creates harmonious sleeping conditions with suitable light and sound throughout the night so you wake up feeling refreshed. Using 'Wellness Coach-sleep' application enables you to monitor the temperature, humidity, sound and the brightness of the light in the bedroom by the various Homni sensors, and you can analyze your sleep environments by detecting body’s movement using Dot sleep sensor data.

Homni has about 16 million built-in lighting colors. You can change the bedroom mood by applying whatever color you want, and sleep while listening to your favorite music through the embedded stereo Bluetooth speaker in Homni.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
